$comment: This app's half of the cross-repository contract, and it is data only.
The laws are not here. They are the failure messages of the gates in
`@nanisoft/prism-ui/gates`, which this app installs by pinning that package
exactly. What is here is what only this app knows: which stylesheet is its
own, how much of it counts as having read something, where its export lands,
what its pack map describes, and which source roots carry no runtime token read.
